content: {"like":["Prefers well-crafted, engaging films and series with strong storytelling and character depth.","Values humor that feels natural and not forced, especially in comedy roles.","Enjoys diverse episode tones—serious, sad, funny, and odd—without over-the-top elements.","Appreciates solid, well-structured pacing that keeps viewers invested.","Loves classic, timeless works that deliver consistent laughs and memorable scenes."],"dislike":["Dislikes CGI stunts and overly artificial visual effects.","Avoids forced or excessive humor that feels contrived or overdone.","Prefers stories without too many subplots or confusing narrative threads.","Rejects pacing that feels rushed or too quick to resolve plot points.","Dislikes prominent catchphrases or gimmicks that distract from the core story."]}
